name: Ookayama
tagline: Shinagawa in 22 minutes and Shibuya in 23 minutes. Served by 2 lines.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Meguro Line and Tokyu Oimachi Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 31 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 22 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 31.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 14.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 31.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 21.8 m to 36.4 m, a difference of 14.6 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 12 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 東急病院, about 8 m away and 中原病院, about 229 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyu Meguro Line and Tokyu Oimachi Line. All 2 lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 52.
